template.name: pw_scf.in

units.name: assign-n-substrate
units.value: len([e for e in INTERFACE.basis.elements if e.value in [x.value for x in BULK_SUBSTRATE.basis.elements]]) / BULK_SUBSTRATE_NATOMS

units.name: assign-n-film
units.value: len([e for e in INTERFACE.basis.elements if e.value in [x.value for x in BULK_FILM.basis.elements] and e.value not in [x.value for x in BULK_SUBSTRATE.basis.elements]]) / BULK_FILM_NATOMS
